definitions.explanation: A professional singer, especially one who performs popular music.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{歌手|かしゅ}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become a famous singer.

examples.japanese: あの{歌手|かしゅ}の{声|こえ}が{好|す}きです。
{人気|にんき}{歌手|かしゅ}のコンサート。

notes:
RELATED WORDS:
- {歌|うた}を{歌|うた}う (to sing a song)
- {歌|か}{曲|きょく} (song - formal)
- アーティスト (artist - loanword)
- ボーカル (vocalist - loanword)
